name: Gherstie
source:
Gherstie (full name is Gherstie Mevela) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and an Azaries's pal; one of main characters.
Gherstie is a young pink blue-eyed om'verai, similar to Azaries. Her mane is white and fin & wing membranes are black, with 2 straight horns directed behind and 2 sickle-shaped ones. Gherstie's neck is decorated with thin spikes and an area between a nose and eyes is covered with dark-red plates. Her belly and rear part of a neck are covered with half-transparent plates.

Younger Gherstie used to have big eyes and brighties nose plates.

Gherstie seems to dislike people from small towns and rural area at first. Gherstie hates courtshipping and has a timid personality. It is hard to impress Gherstie, not to mention her aggressive attitude towards everything said about her scale color.

The game itself uncovers Gherstie as a smart person who can "read" others. Gherstie is straight in terms of her words and enjoys criticizing others. Gherstie hates any kind of too much attention from males.

Gherstie can cook, not so good though.
